시편 124:1.content: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

시편 124:2.content: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

시편 124:3.content: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

시편 124:4.content: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

시편 124:5.content: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

시편 124:6.content: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

시편 124:7.content: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

시편 124:8.content: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
